subject: Vendor onboarding + MSA check-in / compact demo windows
messages:
From: Samantha Park <samantha.park@medivance.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@medivance.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding + MSA check-in / compact demo windows

Hi Soojin / Marissa —

Thanks again for the walk-through last week. Procurement wants to close the remaining MSA items quickly so we can move the pilot to procurement sign-off. Two asks from our side:

1) Can we schedule a short MSA redline call (30–40 minutes) to go over the three open clauses (data retention, audit logs, indemnity)?
2) We also want a compact demo (20–30 minutes) of the private deployment flow for our infra team — ideally back-to-back on the same day.

Our timezone is PDT. Availability this week: Tue 8/24 10:00–12:00 or Thu 8/26 14:00–16:00. If neither works, our fallback is Mon 8/30 afternoon.

I attached a short PDF summarizing the outstanding redlines.

Thanks —
Samantha
Samantha Park
Sr. Procurement Manager, Medivance Health
[samantha.park@medivance.com]
[Attachment: Medivance_MSA_open_items.pdf (pdf)]

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Samantha Park <samantha.park@medivance.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding + MSA check-in / compact demo windows

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the clear list. We can do a combined day and compress both items into a two-slot approach: a focused 35-minute MSA redline call followed by a 25-minute demo for infra. That should keep it under 90 minutes total while giving separate folks the time they need.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 8/24 10:30–11:30 (MSA 10:30–11:05, demo 11:10–11:35)
- Thu 8/26 14:30–15:30 (MSA 14:30–15:05, demo 15:10–15:35)

Marissa will run the MSA redline portion and Karthik will lead the demo. I attached a compact agenda for the demo and a one-page MSA summary from our legal team.

If you confirm a slot, we’ll send calendar invites and a short pre-read.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Demo_Agenda_Compact_v2.docx]

Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 08:05:00 -0700

We may bring our security SME if Marissa anticipates needing extra detail on logs/audit.

Please go ahead and send invites.

— Jordan

Perfect — locking Thu 8/26 14:30–15:30 PDT.

Marissa here from legal. For the redline call, I’ll prepare the clause-by-clause playbook and a recommended compromise for each of the three items Samantha flagged. If Medivance brings a security SME, we’ll keep the demo strictly product-focused and route legal questions to the redline slot.

Pre-reads I’m sending: one-page compromise memo + diffed clause excerpts. Please review before the call; will save time.

[Attachment: MSA_redline_summary.pdf]

— Samantha

- Agenda: 14:30–15:05 MSA redline (Marissa) / 15:10–15:35 Compact infra demo (Karthik).
